concerns.text: T007 is tagged [P] (parallel-safe) but its body requires running the FULL end-to-end pipeline ('chain download → preprocess → training → per-seed inference → metrics → screening') and writing runtime_report.json — this consumes artifacts produced by T005 and T006. The execution-order note partially mitigates this ('T004 ∥ T007-timeout' then T007 after T006), but the [P] tag on the task as written is unsafe: a scheduler honoring it could run the full-pipeline portion before its producers exist. Split the tag (e.g., [P] only for the Timeout unit-test portion) or drop [P] from T007.

T003 writes per-method files results/predictions/uq_predictions_*.csv without specifying which seed they correspond to, while T005 aggregates per-seed files into uq_predictions_aggregated.csv. The producer/consumer chain is order-correct, but the per-method files' seed provenance is ambiguous relative to the seed-varied aggregation T005 performs — state whether per-method files are seed-42 snapshots or seed-aggregated so T005's consumer contract is unambiguous.
